chunks: O my people, beg your Lord to forgive you, then turn to Him in repentance. He will send down rain upon you in abundance, and add strength to your strength, and do not turn away as sinners.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of repentance and seeking forgiveness according to Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In the Shia tradition, this verse is often cited to highlight the causal link between spiritual repentance (tawbah) and material prosperity, emphasizing that divine mercy manifests in both physical blessings like rain and enhanced inner strength. It underscores the concept that true success requires not only seeking forgiveness but also maintaining steadfastness to avoid the fate of the 'mujrimin' (guilty ones).
